meta.name: Pluto TV Pixel World
meta.description:
Pluto TV Pixel World brings you giant blocks of all things Minecraft! Explore some of the wildest mods ever built and tag along with top gamers like Thinknoodles and PrestonPlayz. Don’t miss the excitement on Pluto TV Pixel World!

Shows: Kidnapped by Wizards in Minecraft / Trapped by Zombie Dragons in Minecraft, Episode 10, Whatever You Build in Minecraft, Ill Buy! / So I Adopted PrestonPlayz in Minecraft, Preston Has Only 24 Hours to Live in Minecraft / Preston and I Had a Baby, I Sent Baby Preston to Among Us Minecraft School
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
